title: KPI intake answers file
description: One filled form of the KPI intake pack, as the HTML form saves it. The completeness check reads this file, or a filled workbook that holds the same content.

format.description: The version of this file format.

form.description: Which of the six forms the file holds.

catalogue_version.description: The version of catalogue.toml the form was built from.

kpi_name.description: The answer to question 2.1, repeated so that a person can tell files apart. For the other forms, the answer to their first question; for a term change, the name of the measure it changes.

request.description: The fields the Program manager fills before the interview: number, date, requester_role, invited.

answers.description: The answers by question id. The extra text of a question is under "<id>.detail". A choice holds the id of the chosen item, as pick-lists.json or settings.toml gives it. A special option's id starts with @. The id of an entry that settings.toml adds to a list of the ontology starts with new:.

sign_offs.description: Each signature by the signer's id in catalogue.toml.

consulted.description: Each consultation by its id in catalogue.toml.

example_of.description: Only in the shipped examples: the notation of the measure the example copies. It counts only while 2.1 and 2.2 still equal that measure's name and definition. Leave it empty.
